turn.response: Compliance Vault Pro helps UK landlords and agents manage property compliance in one place. You can add properties, upload necessary certificates, and track requirement statuses and renewal dates. It sends reminders before things expire and allows you to monitor your compliance score, which indicates potential risks based on your records. For example, you can upload a gas safety certificate and see its status tied to the property record. You can also generate reports for inspections or lender inquiries.

turn.user: How much does Compliance Vault Pro cost?
turn.response:
Compliance Vault Pro has three pricing plans: 
- **Solo Landlord**: £19/month + £49 onboarding (up to 2 properties) 
- **Portfolio Landlord**: £39/month + £79 onboarding (up to 10 properties) 
- **Professional**: £79/month + £149 onboarding (up to 25 properties) 

There are also document packs and additional services available for purchase. If you want more details on any specific plan or service, just let me know!
